payload.docs:
Read against the actual shipped surface rather than assumed.

WHAT THE DOCS ARE HERE: v2 has no separate report artifact - the ledger IS the documentation and the board is the everyday report. So the emitted set for this iteration is the ledger nodes it wrote, plus the one durable how-to an owner actually opens.

EMITTED / UPDATED THIS ITERATION:
- se.guidance-phone-setup - the enablement home, now covering all three things an owner needs to know: how to pair, WHEN THEY GET PUSHED (the owner's rule in the owner's words), and how to add the optional brief store. Checked against the surface line by line: the JSON shape matches loadBriefStore's four required fields; 'confirmed servable before it is announced' matches publishBrief; 'expires with its offer, capped at 6h' matches MAX_BRIEF_TTL_S and the offer's own deadline; 'drops to the actions-only rung' matches the whitelist returning null. The doc claims nothing the code does not do.
- Six decision nodes carrying the ADRs, one of them (se.adr-announce-by-adjudicator) RESTATED mid-iteration when the owner corrected my paraphrase - the ledger now carries their wording, not my summary of it.
- Seven RAID entries, four minted at log_gaps.
- Two laws minted earlier in the day and applied here rather than merely cited: se.law-whitelist-guards shaped both new guards, se.law-imports-are-read-only was untouched by this work.

THE MATCH, checked in the direction that matters - from the DOC to the SURFACE, not the reverse, since a doc that describes a surface accurately can still describe one that no longer exists. The one place this bit last time was the verify step: it told the owner to reach a gate and wait for a buzz, which under the new rule correctly never comes for a self-blessed gate. That is now corrected, and it is the kind of drift that only shows up by reading the doc as an owner would follow it.

STILL TRUE ELSEWHERE, checked not assumed: i8c's QR/deep-link documentation describes surfaces this iteration did not touch. se_wait's tool description was updated because it IS a doc - the one an agent reads first.

GAP, named rather than emitted around: there is no single page telling a NEW owner the whole story from nothing to a blessed gate on a phone - the pairing lives in guidance-phone-setup, the brief store now lives beside it, but the connective tissue is the two of them read in order. That is acceptable for a project with one owner who has now read both, and it is exactly the kind of thing that would need to change if this were handed to a stranger.
